title: How do i change sensor correctly?
body: When i change my Libre sensor, my xdrip is not reading the sensor. How do i do it properly?

comments.body: We start a new sensor with the libre device and afterwards with the libre app on the phone. I am not sure that the start with the app is necessary, but with this procedure we have all options: libre device, app and xDrip.
yes, thats right. plus: stop the old sensor in xdrip-menu of course before you scan the new one to go safe that nothings messed up
